open_points.subject: Model M04 — PhotoPlacement.name
open_points.text: `name` is the name M02 gave the source when it was placed
open_points.question: What exact M02 model or fact supplies `PhotoPlacement.name`, and must the deliverer copy that value unchanged or derive the name independently from the source path?
options: Copy the value supplied by M02 unchanged at placement time
Derive the relative name independently when placing the photo
Use M02 only as descriptive provenance while allowing the placement operation to supply the name
open_points.default_guess: Copy the value supplied by M02 unchanged and freeze it in PhotoPlacement at placement time.

witness.initial: A source photo has one filesystem-relative name, while M02 may expose a normalized or otherwise different name; no definition of M02 is supplied.
events: The caller obtains the source through M02.
The caller asks the deliverer to place the photo.
outcomes: PhotoPlacement.name is the exact name supplied by M02.
PhotoPlacement.name is independently derived from the source path and can differ from M02's name.
witness.observer: The Portal or any caller reading PhotoPlacement.name
